geometry_logic.boundary_detection: Detect the scope purely by shape/structure: a circular symbol (dashed or solid circle outline) placed on the wall/elevation surface. Geometry applicability must be decided from the visual shape alone — the model should NOT expect, search for, or rely on the literal text 'FRN-2' being present anywhere in the submittal drawing to confirm geometry. If a circular marker matching this structural description exists anywhere in the elevation view, treat the geometry as applicable, regardless of whether any tag/text label is attached to it.
wall_interaction_conditions: A circular outline (dashed or solid) is visible in the elevation view
The circle boundary may be dashed or solid
A leader line/arrow may or may not connect the circle to a nearby note (presence of leader line is optional, not required)
The circular symbol is mounted on or aligned with the wall/elevation surface
The physical circular marker is identifiable purely by its shape, independent of any tag text, label, or note being present near it
Any one of the above indicators is sufficient to consider the geometry applicable
geometry_logic.expected_boundary_region: Around the wall-mounted circular symbol represented by a dashed or solid outline, including its boundary and any associated leader line. Geometry detection must NEVER depend on finding the text 'FRN-2', tags, leader lines, schedule references, or note text — those are only used afterward to validate the BY OTHERS note, not to first locate the geometry.

pass_condition: Arch drawing has FRN-2 reference (by tag, schedule, or callout) AND submittal shows the circular marker geometry WITH a 'BY OTHERS' note present near it.
fail_condition: Arch drawing has FRN-2 reference AND submittal geometry (circular marker) is present BUT the BY OTHERS note is missing — regardless of whether an 'FRN-2' text tag is visible on the submittal.
FRN-2 scope confirmed from arch but no BY OTHERS responsibility note found near the detected geometry in submittal.
review_required_condition: FRN-2 scope is applicable but the note text is unclear or partially readable.
FRN-2 tag is visible but its connected object or leader region is unclear.
Schedule shows FRN-2, but drawing location is ambiguous.
Multiple nearby notes create uncertainty about whether the BY OTHERS note belongs to FRN-2.
omit_condition: Arch drawing does not contain FRN-2 — scope not applicable.
ARCH REF not found in submittal and arch drawing not available.
Drawing sheet does not contain FRN-2 scope.

reasoning.description: Explain whether FRN-2 scope is applicable, whether the BY OTHERS responsibility note is found, and why the final status is PASS, FAIL, OMITTED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED.

view_results.view_type: Detected actual view title from drawing
